description: For every injective language map \(j:L\hookrightarrow K\), \(j_*T\vdash_K j_*A\) if and only if \(T\vdash_L A\), for sentences in any set-sized signature.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ChangingLanguages.derives_inclusion_iff.{u, v, u', v'} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  {K : FirstOrder.Language} (j : L →ᴸ K) (hj : j.Injective) {T : L.Theory} {A : L.Sentence} :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Derives (j.onTheory T) (j.onSentence A) ↔
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Derives T A
